annotations.text:
Two directions for the same screen. A is Cobalt2 — navy with the signature gold, on a dark walnut table. B leans into the name: spelstugan, a Swedish game cabin — stained pine, linen, falu red, brass lamplight.

Pick one and I'll carry it across the other screens.
The remaining screens are still in Cobalt2 — they follow whichever direction wins.
